recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a man with his chin resting on his hands, set against a warm terracotta background with vertically elongated, ultra-condensed white typography in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's direct gaze creates an immediate connection with the viewer.
The horizontal line of the hands balances the verticality of the text block.
Warm skin tones harmonize with the earthy, orange-brown background.
The dark sweater provides a heavy base that anchors the composition.
coreInvariants: Tight framing on head and hands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and fills approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the resting hands, then up to the vertical text block in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the upper corners to allow the typography to breathe.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with high contrast between the dark clothing and the light text/skin highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (height to width)
Minimal kerning in the main name block
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and R are stretched vertically to appear as narrow ovals/rectangles
E has short horizontal bars to maintain the narrow profile

typesetting.alignment: Justified to match width of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast in width: ultra-condensed stacked display text paired with wide-tracked, small subtitle text.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating the display text from the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and clean sans-serif nature.
Provides the necessary weight and narrow profile if manually scaled.
Geometric and condensed with a similar modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up studio portrait of a Black man with a short beard and mustache, resting his chin on his crossed hands. He is wearing a dark textured sweater over a white collared shirt. The background is a solid, warm terracotta orange. Soft, even lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top right corner, add two lines of ultra-condensed white sans-serif text, stacked vertically. Below them, add a thin white horizontal line, followed by a third line of text in a smaller, wide-tracked sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and white?
Is the background a warm, earthy orange?
Is the subject making direct eye contact?
Is there a thin horizontal line separating the text elements?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact grain/noise pattern of the vintage print
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Ensure the white of the text is bright and legible against the orange.
Verify the 'chin on hands' pose is natural and centered.
Confirm the typography maintains a strictly vertical, condensed appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate Portrait + Warm Earth Tones + Ultra-Condensed Stacked Typography
